desc: Implement backward DP with state (i, char, run-length-class L∈{1,2,3}), base case accepting only L=3, start handled separately.
Store lexicographically smallest next char per (i, char, L=3) state; tie-break cont==switch by min(c, sx).
Fix best/second-best argmin (b2 ← b1 before overwriting b1); use best2 only when best1_x == c.
Execute the embedded harness and the three examples; reported CROSS-CHECK OK over 28440 inputs, zero mismatches, plus crafted best1_x==c case "aaaaabc"→"aaaabbb".
Measure runtime/memory for n=5*10^4: completes in ~2.6 s with a valid good caption, well within limits.
